display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Private is the private jet life: a white glass hangar by the sea with a coffee bar, palms and red carpets - and two long-range business jets waiting for you.

TWO JETS, YOUR COLOURS
Jet One and Jet Two arrive in different liveries. Repaint body, trim, stripes and finish - gloss, matte, metallic, chrome or pearl - and watch it sweep on nose to tail.

A MODERN FLIGHT DECK
Four glass displays, touch screens, side-sticks, thrust levers, flaps, gear and an autopilot under a curved four-pane windshield.

VIP CHARTERS
Fly guests to the islands. Bank too steeply and the coffee spills; land hard and the tip shrinks. Stand up any time and walk the cabin - club seats, galley and a private stateroom.

AN ISLAND PARADISE
A Bahamas-style archipelago: an international airport, a resort town, thirty little cays on a vast shallow sand bank, a deep blue hole and six airstrips - including a short strip on a tiny private cay. Day, sunset or night.

KEEP THEM SPOTLESS
Your jets come home dirty. Grab the pressure washer and blast them back to a showroom shine.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Join a friend's wing or ride in their right seat. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
